name: Bearing False Witness
overview: Scripture clearly forbids bearing false witness, emphasizing the gravity of dishonesty against one’s neighbor as seen in the commandments given in Exodus 20:16 and Deuteronomy 5:20. The Lord not only commands against false testimony but also condemns raising false reports or aligning with the wicked in unrighteousness (Exodus 23:1). Proverbs underscores God's hatred for such sin and assures that false witnesses and liars will face just punishment (Proverbs 6:16; 19:5, 19:9). This teaching highlights the call to truthfulness as a reflection of God’s holiness and justice.
